_comment: Licence-policy gate for tools/Stampd.Tools.Notices. 'allowed' are SPDX ids that may ship. 'reviewed' are packages with custom terms the owner has explicitly reviewed; each needs a reason. Anything else fails the build.

reviewed.reason: Microsoft Software License Terms; section 3(e) forbids redistribution. Reaches Stampd only as a declared dependency of the Stampd.Infrastructure.SqlServer NuGet package (EF Core SqlServer -> Microsoft.Data.SqlClient -> Microsoft.Identity.Client.Broker); consumers fetch it from nuget.org. It must not be bundled into any image or self-contained build. Owner-approved 2026-11-19.
Microsoft Software License Terms permitting distribution of the object code as Distributable Code. Declared dependency of the SqlServer provider only. Owner-approved 2026-11-19.
